description: A component-scoped mobile action bar: up to MaxVisible actions pinned to the bottom edge of the component's own container, with the rest overflowing into a "More" menu that composes TmOverlayPanel (anchored popover on desktop, the shared bottom-sheet primitive on a mobile viewport). The default StickyContainer placement sticks inside the component (position: sticky, never position: fixed like application chrome), so the bar scrolls away with its content; without ChildContent the bar's own root is the sticky box, so a bare container like the dashboard's actually sticks. FixedViewport is a deliberate opt-in that anchors to the viewport and respects the bottom safe area; Inline renders the bar statically at the end of the content. With Auto visibility the bar exists only below the mobile breakpoint, resolved from the container (or from the viewport scope for FixedViewport) through the F1 layout contract; LayoutMode forces a mode for hosts and tests. Bar actions are the bar's own tile buttons (icon over a two-line label) from the shared TmActionItem model (also used by the F4 overflow toolbar); Priority is only an overflow rank — the bar and the menu render in Items order. The ChildContent region renders above the bar at every layout; only the FixedViewport placement reserves body height (the --tm-mobile-action-bar-reserve-block-size token) so nothing is covered at 320 or 390. Reference usage: TmDashboard edit mode on mobile.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The actions. The bar and the "More" menu render in Items order — TmActionItem.Priority is only an overflow rank: the lowest-priority items move into the menu first (ties drop the last item first), partitioned by ActionOverflowLayout. Empty or null renders no bar.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Content the bar belongs to — rendered above it at every layout, never hidden with the bar. For FixedViewport the region gets a bottom padding equal to the bar height while the bar renders (via --tm-mobile-action-bar-reserve-block-size, no overlap at 320 and 390); StickyContainer and Inline bars sit in flow and reserve nothing.

parameters.name: MaxVisible
parameters.description: How many actions stay on the bar before the rest overflow into the "More" menu. Values below 1 are treated as 1.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: Where the bar anchors: StickyContainer (default) sticks to the bottom of the viewport while the component's container is scrolled through, without ever leaving the container's flow; FixedViewport pins the bar to the viewport (left and right edge, bottom safe area) as a deliberate opt-in; Inline renders the bar statically at the end of the content.

parameters.name: MoreLabel
parameters.description: The "More" menu trigger label. Falls back to the localized default.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the bar (role="group"). Falls back to the localized default.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the visibility resolves from. Auto follows the container (or the viewport scope for FixedViewport); a forced value never measures, so a test can render the bar without a DOM. The bar hides whenever the resolved layout is above the mobile breakpoint; the ChildContent always renders.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement. Desktop unless the host says otherwise.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes (the initial value is not a change). Never pair with LayoutMode — a two-way bind would pin the mode.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes for the component root.

examples.title: Edit-mode action bar
examples.code:
<TmMobileActionBar Items="_actions" MaxVisible="3">
    <ChildContent>
        @* the component content the bar belongs to *@
    </ChildContent>
</TmMobileActionBar>

@code {
    private readonly IReadOnlyList<TmActionItem> _actions =
    [
        new() { Id = "add", Label = "Add", Icon = IconNames.Plus, Priority = 100, OnClick = EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, AddAsync) },
        new() { Id = "save", Label = "Save", Icon = IconNames.Save, Priority = 90, OnClick = EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, SaveAsync) },
        new() { Id = "cancel", Label = "Cancel", Icon = IconNames.X, Priority = 80, OnClick = EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, CancelAsync) },
    ];
}
